/api/reviews.selfComments: A busy summer. I ran the July in-service on spinal management and covered most of the early opens. I would like support getting my instructor certification next year.

/api/policies.title: Respectful workplace policy
/api/policies.body: Everyone has the right to a workplace free of harassment and violence. Report concerns to your supervisor or HR; reports are handled confidentially and promptly.

/api/policies.title: Pool safety plan 2026
/api/policies.body:
Every guard on deck carries a rescue tube and wears the guard uniform.

Rotate every 30 minutes; never leave a station unattended.

Report every first-aid incident before the end of the shift.

The head guard checks the AED and first-aid kit at opening.

items.name: Workplace harassment and violence policy
items.nameFr: Politique sur le harcèlement et la violence au travail
items.policyText: Our organization does not tolerate harassment or violence. Report concerns to your supervisor, HR or the health and safety committee. Reports are investigated promptly and kept confidential as far as possible. Nobody will face reprisal for reporting in good faith.

items.name: Privacy and confidentiality
items.nameFr: Confidentialité et protection des renseignements
items.policyText: You may see personal information about the public and coworkers. Use it only for your job, never share it outside work, and report any loss or misuse to your supervisor right away.

items.name: Code of conduct
items.nameFr: Code de conduite
items.policyText: Treat the public and coworkers with respect, follow safety procedures, be on time, and raise concerns early.

/api/signup/settings.terms:
Participants follow instructors’ and lifeguards’ directions at all times.
A full refund is available before the second class; after that, credits only for medical reasons.
Parents or guardians of children under 7 stay on site during lessons.
/api/signup/settings.termsFr:
Les participants suivent en tout temps les consignes des moniteurs et des sauveteurs.
Un remboursement complet est offert avant le deuxième cours; ensuite, des crédits seulement pour raisons médicales.
Les parents ou tuteurs des enfants de moins de 7 ans restent sur place pendant les cours.
/api/signup/settings.payment: Pay at the front desk or by phone within 3 days to keep your spot.
/api/signup/settings.paymentFr: Payez à l’accueil ou par téléphone d’ici 3 jours pour garder votre place.

/api/announcements.title: Annual shutdown starts Monday
/api/announcements.body: The leisure pool closes Monday at 6 a.m. for two weeks of maintenance. Lane swim moves to the main tank. Check your schedule for changes.

payment.remittance: Pay by EFT or cheque. Banking details are on file with your accounts payable team; quote the invoice number.

terms: You authorize FlexcityHeadquarters to debit the account below for the amount of each subscription invoice, on or after its due date.
This is a business pre-authorized debit (Payments Canada Rule H1). The amount varies with each invoice.
Each invoice reaches you at least 10 days before the debit and states the amount and date, unless you waive that notice.
You may cancel this authorization at any time with 30 days’ notice by writing to FlexcityHeadquarters. Cancelling does not end the subscription agreement.

You have certain recourse rights if any debit does not comply with this agreement, for example the right to be reimbursed. For more information, contact your financial institution or visit payments.ca.
